Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Clinically diagnosed facial skin aging

right.raw_text: -  Glogau photoaging score II and III

left.raw_text: -  Body mass index  [AND] ≥20 with adequate abdominal  [OR] or other subcutaneous adipose tissue accessible for lipoaspiration

Exclusion Criteria:
  -  History of keloid formation
metabolic, [OR]  autoimmune  [OR] or endocrinal) or malignancy

right.raw_text: -  Any bleeding  [OR] or coagulation disorder  [OR] or recent use of anticoagulant therapy

left.raw_text: -  History of any previous aesthetic procedure on the face within the past 6 months

right.raw_text: -  History of intake of anti-aging systemic  [OR] or topical medications within the previous 3 months
